title: Prefill-Decode (PD) Disaggregation vs. Colocated Chunked Prefill: Boundary Thresholds, KV Transfer Math & Engine Benchmark

workload_assumptions.model: Llama-3-70B-FP8 (80 layers, GQA n_kv=8, d_h=128) & DeepSeek-671B-MLA

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive Colocated Continuous Batching (Prefill-Prioritized, No Chunking)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 16K Prefill bursts stall Decode for 140ms+, blowing the 25ms TPOT SLA by 5.9x

tiers.name: Tier 2: Colocated + Chunked Prefill (chunk_size=1024/2048 Piggybacked on Decode)
tiers.verdict: Best for <=8 GPUs, short prompts (<2K), or non-RDMA nodes; fails 25ms TPOT on >=8K RAG/Agent

tiers.name: Tier 3: PD Disaggregation Over TCP/IP (No GPUDirect RDMA / NIXL / Mooncake Zero-Copy)
tiers.verdict: Isolates Decode TPOT (21ms), but TCP copy of 2.68GB KV adds +480ms network stall to TTFT

tiers.name: Tier 4: PD Disaggregation (Dynamo/Mooncake/SGLang) + 400G GPUDirect RDMA Layer-Wise KV Push
tiers.verdict: Recommended (>=16 GPUs, Input >=4K, I:O >=8:1): 16.4ms P99 TPOT, 2.18x Goodput & -46.9% $/1M vs Tier 2
